_about: R. Nisbet Bain's (1854-1909) translations of folk tales: Cossack Fairy Tales and Folk Tales (from the Ruthenian collections; a Harrap printing) and Ignácz Kúnos's Turkish Fairy Tales and Folk Tales (the 1901 printing). Bain is the translator of both. The 1901 printing of the Turkish book ends with four Roumanian fairy tales; the book does not name a separate translator for them. Clean Gutenberg text; public domain. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
